# Georgia SEO Company

> SEO and web design for Georgia businesses

Georgia SEO Company is a registered Georgia company based at 246 N 5th Ave SW, Rome, GA 30165. Owner and operator: Eric Kirby. Phone: (762) 999-7265. The company serves service and trade businesses across Georgia, working from Rome in the northwest of the state.

## Services

- [SEO Services for Georgia Businesses](https://www.georgiaseocompany.com/seo-services/): SEO services for Georgia businesses: the Google Business Profile, the site, the citations, and a monthly report you can check in your own Search Console.
